story.fullStory:
Pearl Jam's "Alive" — original release 1991. "Alive" is the debut single by American rock band Pearl Jam.

It was released on July 7, 1991, 51 days before the release of the band's debut album, Ten, on which "Alive" appears.

Written by guitarist Stone Gossard, the song originated as an instrumental titled "Dollar Short" and was included on a demo tape circulated in hopes of finding a singer for the group.
